name: Tense Politeness
description: A slight smile followed by grimace showing polite tension or forced pleasantness.
meaning: Used when trying to be polite but things are awkward or tense. Forced smile energy.
examples: When they ask how work is going 🙂😬
seoDescription: What does 🙂😬 mean? The slight smile and grimace combo explained. Used for tense, forced politeness.
